title: Composition identity for the specified forward cartesian unit-cohomology map
statement: Let k→kprime be a commutative-ring algebra map, f:C→Spec k, and h display a cartesian square Cprime with projections iotaprime and fprime [def-pc-base-change]. Set d=h.isoPullback.hom, M=(O_C)_{kprime}, and e=pullbackObjUnitIso(baseChangeFst f). The forward map L=unitCohomologyPullbackLinear(baseChangeSnd f,fprime,d,hd,M,e.hom followed by unitToPushforwardObjUnit d,n) [def-pbc-unit-cohomology-pullback-linear] satisfies L(H.baseChangeLinear(f,O_C,n)(x)) equal to ordinary structural pullback of x along iotaprime for every x∈HOver(f,O_C,n) [def-pc-flat-cohomology-comparison]. This is an equality for a specified map, with no existence or bijectivity conclusion.

source.place: cohomology-equation-functorial; exact inverse-image action on Ext, and Mathlib adjunction and unit pullback APIs

proof.text: Use the first projection identity d followed by baseChangeFst equals iotaprime. The unit-pullback adjunction identity identifies baseChangeUnit followed by pushforward of e.hom with the structural unit map. Naturality moves e through the adjoint coefficient map; structural maps compose on every open. Apply coefficientUnit_comp to identify composite adjoint coefficient maps.

The constant-integer comparisons compose with the same inverse-image comparison by uniqueness of left-adjoint comparisons. Functoriality of exact-functor action on Ext and associativity of Ext composition identify the composite cohomology map with structural pullback. This proves compatibility without using bijectivity.

proof_origin.place: The explicit Ext comparison, naturality and functoriality; the complete argument is in the Lean docstring.
